entry.title: Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga v2.0.0
entry.content:
Almost a full rewrite of the APWorld's logic (just True Jedi logic that is unchanged). - Each Minikit location has its own logic now, instead of before, where all Minikits in a chapter would only enter logic when you could reach all 10 in a chapter. - Logic Difficulty options for different levels of skill/knowledge - None: Tries to match developer intended strategies, for players new to the game - Normal: No glitches expected, and Extras in logic, for players that have played most of the vanilla content - Moderate: Simpler glitches expected, for players that play the Archipelago randomizer often and are willing to learn simpler tricks - Hard: More difficult jumps and tricks, for players starting to learn speedrun tricks (installing *BrickBench* to assist in learning tricks is recommended) - Expert/Super Expert logic difficulties are planned, but are not being worked on at this time - Exactly what tricks are expected by each Logic Difficulty are highly subject to change based on player feedback. Some tricks may be more difficult to understand while there are no videos explaining the tricks, so please take into consideration that videos of tricks are planned.
Minikit location names are highly subject to change (maybe a google form can be put together for the discord channel to suggest better names).
There is currently no PopTracker pack, and the client's Universal Tracker support does not include maps. The PopTracker pack is being worked on to support the v2.x.x APWorlds.
There is currently no document/videos detailing all the logic tricks in each difficulty. Most tricks have comments in the logic data for the corresponding Chapter/Bonus level https://github.com/Mysteryem/Archipelago-TCS/tree/main/lego_star_wars_tcs/data/logic (note that the `None` logic difficulty is referred to as the `base` logic internally and `er_rule`s are not used currently, but may contain relevant trick comments). If you would like to contribute videos of tricks, please upload them to YouTube.
# Known Issues - The pause screen text for showing goal progress does not get reset properly when closing the client, so the text can stack up if you open and close the client repeatedly - Boss-related options have erroneously included `Darth Vader (3-6)` in the allowed bosses and maximum number of bosses that can be enabled. Yamls intending to enable the 3-6 boss should use `Anakin Skywalker (3-6)`.
# Logic Rewrite - Logic is rewritten to use Rule Builder and logical regions - Minikits now have individual logic - Four Logic Difficulty options for different player skill/knowledge - Uncap OT High Jump option considered by logic
# Client - /toggle_windowed command allows for playing in a window without DxWnd - Debug commands to peek at game memory - APWorld version now shown in the client description and window title - Customised Death Link death messages - Active Extras are written into save data and restored by the client - Replaced some of the fake items names with even faker sounding names
# New Options - Logic Difficulty - Logic option for whether 2-1 expects progressing with pod racers - Non-vehicle Max Health - Vehicle Max Health - Random options for Goal Chapter
# Universal Tracker support - `/explain` support for rules - Deferred events support - Glitched logic shows +1 logic difficulty by default - `/ut_toggle_all_glitches` shows the highest logic difficulty. If using the standalone Universal Tracker client, this command is not available, but you can `/manually_collect UT_GLITCHED_ALL` instead
# Changes - Anakin's Flight and A New Hope are now played in Free Play mode - Attempting to play a level in Story mode that should be played in Free Play kicks the player back to the Cantina now, instead of just warning them - No Minikit items in the item pool if the minikit goal is disabled - Removed Luke Skywalker (Dagobah) being able to complete Dagobah (logic accounts for this now) - Removed Yoda/Yoda (Ghost) getting a speed increase at the start of 3-6 (logic accounts for this now)
# Fixes - Fix Yoda/Yoda (Ghost) being able to perform glitchy wall jumps - Fix Yoda logically being able to wear hats - Fix the client thinking you're not playing when shadows are off - Fix slot name/seed name clobbering Challenge mode timer data
# Internal - Slot data handling entirely rewritten and much easier to update now - Most use of string literals replaced with StrEnum/IntEnum - Added some generation tests - Add future-proofing check that the seed name is not too long - Add check that the slot name does not encode to too many bytes - Refactored __init__.py to be smaller, extract code elsewhere - Bumped minimum AP version to 0.6.8

entry.title: Pokemon HGSS Singe v0.12.0
entry.content:
# **Pokemon HGSS Singe APWorld v0.2.7** New seeds needed ;A seed generated with v0.2.6 keeps working with the v0.2.6 apworld: finish it with that one, and generate new seeds with this one. The BizHawk Client warns you when a seed and the installed apworld do not match.
## Files - poke_hgss.apworld: the world. Put it in your Archipelago custom_worlds folder. - Poke_HGSS.yaml: the default options file, ready to edit. - poke_hgss_tracker.html: web tracker, open it in your browser (double-click). - poke_hgss_poptracker.zip: PopTracker pack, drop it in PopTracker's packs folder. Source code: the .zip and .tar.gz GitHub attaches to this release.
## How to update - Delete the old poke_hgss.apworld from custom_worlds, then add this one (the Launcher's "Install APWorld" does not overwrite an existing file). - Your YAML keeps working. Every new option is off by default, except unlock_button and forget_hm_moves; the roadblock settings (elite_four_badges, blue_kanto_leaders, red_badges) keep the original numbers by default. - Generate a new seed.
## Highlights - New checks (all off by default) - Shops: shopsanity, the 13 town Poke Marts each sell 2 Archipelago items (26 checks), bought once; entering a Mart hints its slots. randomize_shop_items randomizes the Mart stock (TMs and HMs included, one at a time) and `shop_key_items` lets key items be on sale too. With a shop option on, wild battles give a little money. - Game Corner prizes (`game_corner_prizes`): the 20 item prizes of Goldenrod and Celadon, 50 Coins each (win them at Voltorb Flip), taken once. - Apricorn trees (`apricorn_trees`): the first Apricorn of each of the 31 trees; the Apricorn Box is needed. - Bug-Catching Contest (`bug_contest`): one check for taking part; the contest is held every day.
## New goals and roadblocks - goal: pokedex (catch a number of species, `goal_pokedex_count`) and goal: `legendary_hunt` (catch fixed legendaries, `goal_legendary_count`, 1 to 6). - `elite_four_badges` (badges the logic expects before the League, any of the 16, default 8), `blue_kanto_leaders` (Kanto Leaders Blue wants beaten, default 7) and `red_badges` (badges Prof. Oak wants before Mt. Silver, default 16).
## More randomizers (all off by default) - `randomize_trades` (the 9 in-game trades), `randomize_static_pokemon` (gifts and fixed encounters), `randomize_tm_compatibility` (half or full), `randomize_wild_held_items`, `randomize_abilities`, `similar_strength_trainers` (randomized trainers keep a comparable strength); `exclude_legendaries` now covers trainer parties too. With `randomize_wild_pokemon` on, swarms, night fishing and radio species are randomized too, and the Pokedex AREA page follows your seed.
## Quality of life - Unlock button (`unlock_button`, on by default): the SOUND row of the in-game Options becomes UNLOCK and sends you back to the last Pokemon Center, healed. No more stuck seeds. - Forget HM moves (`forget_hm_moves`, on by default): HM moves can be replaced like any other move; HMs are never used up. HMs from the Bag (`hms_without_teaching`, off by default): Cut, Rock Smash, Strength, Rock Climb, Surf, Waterfall and Whirlpool work as soon as the HM is in the Bag (with the usual badge); Fly and Flash still need a Pokemon that knows them. - Hidden item markers (`hidden_item_markers`, off by default): a gold Poke Ball marks every hidden item you have not taken yet. Note: hidden items are always part of the pool; `hidden_items_require_dowsing_machine` only decides whether the logic expects the Dowsing Machine before them. - /report client command: prints a short state report to paste when asking for help.
## Trackers - **Web tracker**, plans of every map: all 448 maps drawn from your own ROM, each check on its tile, numbered doors, zoom and drag. The world map is rendered from the ROM too: click an area to open its plan, or a neighbouring area from a plan. New NPC tab, Pokedex and Trainers counters per area (click to list only what is missing). - **Follow my character**: the BizHawk client sends your position; the web tracker and the PopTracker pack open the map you are on by themselves.
Yellow checks and broadcast view: both trackers show in yellow the checks you can already reach although the logic does not expect them yet; the web tracker gets a clean broadcast view for streams (button, or #broadcast at the end of the file address).
PopTracker pack rebuilt: World tab, then a tab for every town, route, dungeon and building, each check at its place. Both trackers know the new checks and goals.
## Experimental `foreign_item_names` (off by default) shows the real name and owner of an item picked up for another player.
## Fixes - Softlock at the Olivine port when arriving by boat before the Elite Four. - Prof. Elm's Everstone check follows the randomized Togepi line. - Ecruteak start: Bill's PC scene no longer pushes a whited-out player behind the counter. - The Kanto Fly map unlocks after arriving by Magnet Train. - Blue on Cinnabar Island counts every Kanto Leader whose check is done, even a win lost from your save; he no longer stays one Leader short. - S.S. Aqua: the ship arrives again on later trips after a first trip from Vermilion, or after a white out between the Metal Coat and leaving the ship. - Strong held items and PP Up / PP Max / Max Elixir are now "useful" items. - A randomized trade never asks for the species it gives. - Randomized trades: the trading NPCs now name the species they actually ask for and offer.
- Patching a seed is several times faster (about 8 s instead of a minute). - The Jade Orb is now in logic (Oak only needs this version's legendary); Escape Rope logic for the Ruins of Alph north-east hidden room. - Cianwood City removed from starting_town; Trainersanity no longer includes the Team Rocket trainers the client sends automatically; Dexsanity ignores the 1% encounter slots.
- Full details in CHANGELOG.md.
Use of an LLM This project is developed with the help of an LLM. Every change is reviewed, the main files are read, and fixes are tested in game on HeartGold and SoulSilver before release. Details in the README.

entry.content:
# ARK-Ipelago Evolved v0.3.4
This release introduces a new **Cave Trail Recorder** that I was using to map caves for PopTracker, improved DeathLink messages, support for building mods added mid-game, and several important logic, plugin, and tracker fixes.
## New Features
### DeathLink Improvements - **Custom Death Messages:** DeathLink messages now describe what killed you, including messages such as: > "Ghios tried feeding a Raptor, but the Raptor ate Ghios instead." - **Shared Slot Support:** DeathLinks received from other games now kill every survivor connected to the same slot instead of just one.
### Mid-Game Building Mod Support - Added `/aplatemod <mod id>` to support building mods installed after seed generation. - Supports **Structures Plus (S+)**, **Super Structures (SS)**, and the **Note Tracker** mod. - Only unlocks modded versions of structures you've already unlocked, preserving progression.
### Cave Trail Recorder (`/aptrail`) A new tool for recording cave exploration paths and generating cave maps.
**Commands:** - `/aptrail start <cave>` — Start recording a cave route. - `/aptrail mark <label>` — Mark a specific location. - `/aptrail stop` — Stop recording. - `/aptrail pause` and `/aptrail resume` — Pause or resume recording.
**Additional Mapping Features:** - **Movement Types:** `swim`, `fly`, `walk`, `wire`, and `lava` identify how you're traveling. - **Room Mapping:** `room` and `fillroom` allow you to map rooms by walking their boundaries. - **Environmental Mapping:** `fillroom lava` and `fillroom water` allow you to designate lava-filled and water-filled areas.
### New Talon Checks
**Ragnarok** - Fire Talon ×2 and ×10 - Lightning Talon ×2 and ×10 - Poison Talon ×2 and ×10
**Valguero** - Fire Talon ×2 and ×10
### Valguero Guardian's Sanctuary - Dragon, Manticore, and Megapithecus are now treated as one combined boss encounter. - Each difficulty uses its actual in-game tribute requirements. - Progression logic is based on the **Gamma** recipe.
## Logic Changes - Removed Prime Fish checks from Scorched Earth.
## Bug Fixes - Fixed Tek engrams remaining locked after completing the goal. - Fixed boss kills not being marked as completed in PopTracker. - Fixed item delivery messages displaying "sent X to Y" without identifying which check sent the item. - Fixed the Ragnarok Blue Obelisk visit failing to send its check. - Fixed numerous other Ragnarok visit checks that were not triggering correctly.
## Additional Downloads The following community tools are also included as attachments in this release:
[Lurch's PopTracker](https://github.com/lurch9229/Arkipelago-Poptracker/releases) [Avocado's Launcher](https://github.com/aSoberAvocado/ARK-Ipelago-Evolved-Launcher/releases)

entry.title: Final Fantasy Resonance v0.30.0
entry.content:
# v0.30.0 (apworld 0.30.0, mod 0.61.0) — Public Playtest #3
Build 3 of the Final Fantasy Resonance randomizer for [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg/). Once you finish a seed (or hit a wall), give your feedback in the Discord thread.
## New Stuff * Side quests can be shuffled now * All bosses (including cave masters) give out Crystal Fragments **and** an AP item * You can set both to be priority locations in the yaml * You can Fast Travel from inside dungeons * "Gift" NPCs are checks (the old guy outside the Colosseum, etc.) * COLORS! * New Archipelago menu option - all AP settings are there now, plus a work-in-progress "tracker" page * Lid's Mechabo quests are now included
## What needs testing
Turn on `include_side_quests` in your YAML (it's off by default) so you can hit the new quest checks. Let me know what worked and what broke—if something fails, please attach your `UE4SS.log`.
* **The Archipelago menu page:** Open this from the in-game main menu. Make sure the **Settings** tab actually updates EXP, gil, MRP, encounters, encounter rate, and scaling. Check that the **Seed** tab displays your goal, checks, and continents, and that scrolling works properly with a gamepad. * **Boss checks:** All bosses—story bosses included—now drop both an Archipelago item and a Crystal Fragment. Verify that: * Winning shows a pop-up with the AP item. * The feed logs `Received Crystal Fragment (N/M)`. * Loading an older save where bosses are already dead retroactively sends their fragments. * **Boss YAML options:** Roll one seed with `priority_story_bosses: true` (new option, off by default) and another with `priority_bosses` (renamed to "Priority Cave Masters" in the YAML), then check where progression ends up. * **NPC gifts:** 8 one-time NPC gifts are now randomized checks (like the Colosseum old man's Lunar Sword/Brigandine and the Magi-tenna NPC in Gaberada when radar treasures are active). Make sure: * The pop-up shows the AP item instead of a Potion. * Opening a chest near an unvisited gift NPC still displays the chest's actual item. * **Research Center Ruins key cards:** All three key card spots are now AP locations, and the doors should unlock using the cards you receive from the server. * **Side quests:** * **Pop-ups:** Reward pop-ups show the AP item (including Token Legacy, Mog Tag, and The Call from Beyond). * **Secondary rewards:** Quests that normally give a second item, vision, or gil now grant a second location. The pop-up should show both items. * **Quests screen:** The Rewards list accurately shows what each quest is holding. * **Verun's Mechabo chain:** "Arise, Mechabo!", "Mechabo Evolved", and "Mechabo Unleashed" can be completed in sequence. * **Dirnado quest logic:** If you're on foot in Dirnado without the Airship, Lyrical Riddles and Elven Maven should stay out of logic until Liquid Thunder is reachable. * **Item text colors:** Item names should be color-coded by AP classification (light blue = filler, dark blue = useful, purple = progression, red = trap) in the item feed, chest pop-ups, and the Quests screen.
## Known issues
* **Pop-ups occasionally show the vanilla item:** The check still goes through to the server, it's just a visual text bug. I've seen this happen in two spots: * Triggering two checks at the exact same time (like opening a chest immediately after a boss fight)—the second pop-up glitches. * The Iron Giant win pop-up (happened once in testing). * **Character quest stat boosts:** Things like "Attribute Bonus: Fina" aren't randomized checks—those still apply normally like in the base game. * **ModSettings map-change crash:** The `ModSettings` UE4SS Lua mod (`Mods\ModSettings`, from FFR Modding Tools) can crash the game a couple seconds after changing maps, even without this randomizer installed. You can dodge it by doing either of these: * Uncheck **Hint on map load** in the ModSettings menu (`F10`). * Set `ModSettings : 0` in `Mods\mods.txt` (this only disables the Lua hotkey; the Blueprint mod itself keeps working). * **Invisible ladder at Mt. Thunderclap:** The shortcut ladder has no mesh. You can still examine the top of the cliff to drop it and climb down, you just can't see it. * **Still vanilla / not implemented:** Espers other than Siren are still obtained normally, and the Chamber of Arms and Arena haven't been touched yet.
## Downloads
| File | What it is | |---|---| | `FFRArchipelago.zip` | UE4SS Lua game mod (v0.61.0, build `0e1022be`) | | `ff_resonance.apworld` | Archipelago world and FFR Client (v0.30.0, build `fbcc579c`) | | `Final Fantasy Resonance.yaml` | Default player YAML template |
**Setup notes:** * Make sure you grab the mod and apworld from this same release. The mod logs `version 0.61.0 (build 0e1022be)` to `UE4SS.log` on startup, and the client prints its build hash when it launches. * **Wipe and replace the whole `FFRArchipelago` folder**. * **Generate a fresh seed.** v0.29.0 seeds don't know about the new locations. * Need a refresher on setup? Check the [README](https://github.com/wrjones104/ffresonance-archipelago#installation).
---
*Note: Most of the code and documentation for this project was written with Claude and tested by hand—see [[DISCLOSURE.md](http://disclosure.md/)](https://github.com/wrjones104/ffresonance-archipelago/blob/main/DISCLOSURE.md) for the full breakdown.*

entry.title: Homura-Hime v0.4.4
entry.content:
Gameplay release: large batches of items and traps are spread out to avoid frame hitches, key items and Soul Cores that go missing are given back, and a new option leaves the first Pretty Little Flower to the story. See README for installation instructions.
**Update the plugin and the .apworld together.** Seeds from 0.4.x still play with this plugin (the new option only applies to seeds generated with this world; an older seed keeps the Flower as an item), and saves and server records are not touched.
### New:
**Skip Early Macguffin Checks (`skip_early_macguffin_checks`, on by default):**
- When Chapter 1 is the first world you play, the Pretty Little Flower is left to the story. It is not an item of the multiworld, its hand-over in Level 1 Area 1 is not a location, and you get the Flower the way the base game gives it. The logic counts on it from the start of the chapter. - It does nothing when another world comes first (a randomized order, or a freeform key setup that starts elsewhere), or when you turn it off: then the Flower is shuffled like the other key items and its hand-over is a check. - It is part of the Standard preset and of the sample YAML.
**Large batches of items and traps are spread over several frames:**
- Received items are handed to the game 5 per frame, in the order you received them, instead of in one long frame. Reconnecting after a long time away, or a `!release`, no longer freezes the game. - Traps are all read in at once, but go off at a limited pace: at most 2 traps in any 5 frames, and at most 6 traps out at once. A trap counts until every enemy it spawned has been defeated (or left behind when you change scene); only then does the next one go off. - A Hexed Doll Trio Trap waits while a Blue Hexed Doll (Aoi) is alive. The Blue doll shields the enemies near it, so two of them in one fight shield each other and cannot be killed. - Defeated trap enemies are removed from the scene. The game only switches a dead enemy off, so hundreds of them used to pile up (over 250 in one scene) and cost frame rate.
**Soul Core gates and NPC item checks count what the multiworld has sent:**
- A Soul Core door, trigger or teleport, and an NPC that asks you for an item (Nurikabe, the elevator, the Level 1 house), no longer refuse you for an item the multiworld says you have but that is missing from your inventory. The item is given at that moment and the quest goes on. - It can be switched off with the config setting `Progress` / `CountReceivedItems`.
### Fixes:
- **Key items and Soul Cores that went missing are given back.** Equipment already was; now the seven key items (Pretty Little Flower, Elevator Lever, Nurikabe's Shoe, Hat and Gloves, Fresh Fish, Inugami Certificate) and the five Soul Cores are too. The check runs when a save loads and a few seconds after a batch of items has been handed over. This fixes a player whose Flower was missing after many items arrived at once. - **Finishing the Level 1 Area 1 doll and flower quest checks the Flower's location** if the hand-over was skipped (for example by finishing the quest with a Flower that was sent to you), so the check is not lost.
### Changes:
- The Standard preset, the sample YAML and the world's guide describe the new option. - New tests: the pacing of items and traps, the trap limits, the Blue doll rule, the repair of key items (replaying the batch from a player's log), and the world option with and without Chapter 1 first. The game tests' seed keeps the Flower location, because they expect every location of the catalog.
### Known issues:
- A key item that a quest uses up (the Pretty Little Flower is taken by the house NPC) is given back by the repair after the next reload or batch of items. It does no harm, but is not vanilla behavior.

entry.content:
Release candidate **v0.6.0-rc2**, built from merged main commit `06f398912b0e5cedbef892807ddbc60de1f303df` (PR #1125). This is a prerelease for testing, not the stable release.
### Changes since RC1 - Validate the Room 4-16 source route whenever RoomSanity or 100% Game Completion requires it, under both Full and Minimal accessibility. The Room 4-17 bypass does not visit Room 4-16. - Shuffled now selects the first qualifying policy through the existing deterministic search. Logic, slot data and ROM patching use that same policy; Off retains native Foley Bomb. - Completely Random and an ineligible Shuffled 100% no-ability policy are refused before fill with setting-specific guidance. Disabling RoomSanity alone does not bypass the 100% goal's physical room-visit requirement. Outside either option, this optional exit is not a source-preflight requirement.
Install **kirbyam.apworld**; it contains the committed patch, not a full game ROM. The provenance receipt and signed attestation bundle are verification files. Regenerate seeds to use the corrected generation logic; updating the APWorld does not rewrite existing seeds.
Remaining physical-acquisition and encounter coverage is tracked in [v1.0.0 follow-up #1122](https://github.com/hasherwi/Archipelago-kirbyam/issues/1122). This RC does not claim complete route coverage or a completed full playthrough.
## v0.6.0
### New Features - Add 100% Game Completion Goal: all rooms, chests, levers, Big Switches, and Dark Mind clear. Health upgrades do not add completion requirements since there can be a variable amount (Issue #204). - Added "Phone a Friend" as a standard progression item (PR #1086). This gates Kirby's ability to call other Kirbys to the player, but not to return to Central Circle. - All sixteen Goal Games award a check when completed, including runs with no prizes (PR #1026). - Add the default-off `Advanced Logic` toggle under `Make the game harder`; enabling it allows reviewed Crash and Magic traversal routes (PR #1092).
### Improvements - Support YAML-less Universal Tracker tracking for newly generated seeds by restoring their resolved settings, enemy ability assignments, starting inventory and excluded locations (PR #1102). - Improve in-game wooden boards over locked area transition mirrors, preserving their original frames (Issue #1027, PR #1105). - Improved Logic for Item Placement and Accessible Locations (PR #1092, PR #1103, Issue #1099).
### Known Limitations - Phone charges can exceed three, but the battery display does not show the extra charges (PR #1086). - Ranged-attack coverage remains incomplete. Three targets retain older rules outside reviewed source assignments; broader physical outcomes still need review. See the [detailed coverage ledger](dev-docs/ranged-coverage-ledger.md) (PR #1052). - Only the North American ROM is supported; AP notifications are English. - Chests retain their original item sprites and collection animations; statues retain their original ability appearance. - mGBA notifications require the visible **Archipelago Connector** scripting panel; they are plain text, not game-image overlays. - Testing covers selected gameplay scenarios, not a complete playthrough or every multiplayer setup.
### Bug Fixes - Logic previously only cared if you unlocked an ability, not if it was actually obtainable from an enemy or statue. This is fixed. Miniboss and area boss spawns are also considered but only under the new Advanced Logic option (PR #1116). - Corrected the Chalk chest compartment (PR #1086). - Keep the Mustard Mountain Room 15 timed exit out of logic when no reviewed source-backed route is available, including mixed/failable source policies (Issue #1099). The ordinary Room 17 bypass remains available.
### Internal Changes - Detailed Phone source and historical validation records remain in the [Phone documentation](dev-docs/phone-progression-admission.md) (PR #1086). - Record bounded Rainbow Route East Map Chest acquisition, independent native cold persistence and real-server delivery evidence; full-goal acceptance remains pending. - Validate receipt-first Carrot Castle physical save/cold-load in all three native files using real starting-item delivery; full-goal acceptance remains pending. - Extend bounded Moonlight physical-first real-server reconnect validation to all three native files; this is not full-completion acceptance. - Persist physical lever pulls alongside seed-bound Hub checks without granting wall ownership or changing the native save layout.

entry.title: Links Awakening DX Beta v14.0.0
entry.content: Big update! Most of these are ports or remixes of [LADXR](https://ladxr.daid.eu) features. (Thank you!) ## New/Changed Options - `condense_dungeons`: The upstream `nodungeons` overworld setting, but applied to individual dungeons. A condensed dungeon is shrunk to a tiny three room experience. - This can be combined with `dungeon_dive` overworld for a 26 location boss rush! Be warned that this specific case required extreme item pool trimming, so no heart containers. - This also makes it easier to exclude dungeons! If you set `exclude_locations: [ Tail Cave ]` it will automatically condense the dungeon and remove its instrument (unless instruments are shuffled outside the dungeon), and exclude its few remaining locations. - `specific_optional_dungeons`: Allows you to condense or exclude any dungeons that aren't necessary for the specific instruments goal. - `owlsanity`: Change owl statues from hints to locations. This adds up to 33 locations. - `in_game_hint_item_groups`: (replaces `other in_game_hint_*` settings) Specify item groups to make in-game hints for. It will try to make a hint for each of these until it runs out of items or books/statues. - `boss_shuffle`/`boss_plando` - `miniboss_shuffle`/`miniboss_plando` - `enemizer`: Randomize a lot of overworld enemies. - `overworld: open_beach`: New overworld setting, similar to `open_mabe` but lets you go from Toronbo Shores to Martha's Bay without power bracelet. Still gets you out of Mabe but not quite as fast. - `filler_pool`: Control the filler item generator. - Added some new powerups/traps that will only show up if added to `filler_pool`: Guardian Acorn, Piece of Power, Recovery Heart, Fairy, Death, Slime Storm, Bomb Drop, Cucco Party, Anti-Heart Container. - `reserve_filler`: (replaces `more_filler`) Similar, but you can specify how much filler, and it can go to pretty extreme levels. ## Other Changes/Fixes - New Archipelago item icon for `foreign_item_icons: indicate_progression` (icon by AceBreaker) - Seashell mansion 5 and 10 seashell locations are back! - Fixed Tunic Fairy giving the wrong item text. - Evil Eagle now only requires L1 shield in normal logic. I was down to needing one more cuttable item to make boss rush possible, so I made the change so I could cut a shield there. (L1 and L2 shield function the exact same for Evil Eagle fyi). - Shortened some texts, cut some text boxes. - Skips text on most non-progression items (and rupees) when received. - Extend hint info for items in dungeons. - Dungeon items have a `start_inventory` option that is a shortcut to putting them in `start_inventory_from_pool`. - Start inventory items come in with no text boxes after talking to tarin (even offline!). - Fix Zol Attacks not working locally sometimes. - Disabling trade quest now removes the locations. - yaml-less universal tracker support

This is a release candidate for a new "GameCube" (dolphin only for now) version of the ap world! The PC port has **no visible changes** but has been almost entirely refactored, so if you want to help test by playing the PC port, you still can!
I recommend **not updating** to this version unless you want to help test! There are no new features beyond the GameCube version.
## How to play the new GameCube version: - You will need a copy of Dolphin with the "dolphin memory engine". If you've ever played other gamecube AP worlds, you already have this. Otherwise, just get the latest version - You will need the usual Animal Crossing US ISO - Install the new apworld, then open the launcher and select **Animal Crossing Gamecube Patcher** - Select your iso, then select the output location. You only need to patch once per version, not once per seed. - There is a new **Animal Crossing Gamecube Client** in the launcher, which you use to connect to Dolphin. You can load the client or Dolphin in any order. - Connect to archipelago in the client, selecting your slot name - In game, you should see the menu state show connected. You can now play as usual.
**Open the AP menu in-game with Z+Start**
Some features are currently disabled in the GameCube version, but none are related to playing the seed (just stuff like outdoor furniture etc).

entry.title: Nine Sols v0.7.1
entry.content:
For installation instructions [see the README](https://github.com/Ixrec/NineSolsArchipelagoRandomizer?tab=readme-ov-file#installation).
- Visiting the Boundless Repository Gauntlet after Yanlao's death will now pretend Yanlao is still alive. In vanilla, the Gauntlet removes several boxes on revisits so you don't need Yanlao to snipe boxes, but several of those box removals would completely change randomizer logic. This has technically been broken since day one, but we only noticed this problem after ER created unbeatable seeds that forced players to do the Claw fight before the Gauntlet. - In 0.7.0 ER it was possible to softlock yourself by arriving at an elevator that normally requires hacking to unlock, then immediately hacking the hack point next to it. Now the randomizer mod will set the flags to permanently unlock these elevators on arrival, so the hack point becomes a no-op instead. - The lower GoS (East) -> GoS (West) connection is blocked by pillars until you trigger a spike ball in GoS (East) to destroy them. The logic surrounding this was incorrect in a way that did not matter before, but causes unbeatable seeds in ER. Now this logic correctly requires that you can trigger the GoS (East) spike ball before assuming you can access these entrances. - Previously, most shop locations were not in logic until you gained access to enough parts of the map. Due to an oversight, Kuafu's shop was an exception, so unlocking his shop early could still lead to an early required jin grind (which became a much bigger problem when ER produced a layout with no early enemies). The Kuafu shop logic has been reworked, so even his "low cost" shop locations now also require some "map access." - `vanilla` logic: - W&OS now has logic for starting from the Left Exit, which we realized is important in ER. - `ledge_storage` logic: - "Factory (PA) - Lower Left Elevator" to "Root Node" now allows wall slide with CL setup. - "Yinglong Canal - Egg Cave & Left Exit" to "Above Egg Cave" using multiple LS vaults with AD setup and a bow hover.

entry.title: Gravity Circuit (MuratDev's Implementation) v0.11.0
entry.content:
### New - **Linux / Steam Deck support (Proton).** When WinHTTP's websockets aren't available, the client connects through LÖVE's LuaSocket instead (`ws://` only; archipelago.gg and self-hosted servers accept it). Run `sh install.sh` to install the mod into the game's Proton prefix. - **Shopsanity info in the shop itself.** The shop's description box shows what the selected slot sends and to whom, with the item name coloured by class (progression, useful, filler, trap).
### Changes - **New overlay.** Messages use the game's font, coloured like the Archipelago text client, and sit in the bottom left so they no longer cover the health bar. The AP status line moved to the top; it hides a few seconds after connecting and comes back when disconnected, paused or with F9 open. - Money cache pickups and applied refills no longer print a message. - **Clearer connection errors.** The client says what went wrong (unknown host, nothing on that port, timeout, not an Archipelago server, wrong slot or password) and what to check. Pasted addresses are cleaned up, and a bad address or a refused connection no longer retries forever. - Fewer hitches: server messages are decoded off the main thread, data packages are cached between connections, and the log is written in batches.
### Logic - **"Data Chip - Nega"** now requires all 8 stage Access items. The chip is inside the HQ healing tube, which only opens after all 64 rescues.
### Fixes - Fixed checkpoint refills not filling the new segment after receiving a Burst Booster.
### PopTracker - The pack (now 0.7.0) shows hub NPC data chips (Fix, Shock, Yuki, K.I.D, Amadeus, Mighty, Tech) as Inspect until the rescue that brings that NPC to HQ is checked, and follows the new Nega logic.

entry.title: Final Fantasy Resonance v0.31.0
entry.content:
# v0.31.0 (apworld 0.31.0, mod 0.62.0): public playtest, fourth build
This one is mostly about enemy scaling. After a lot of AP runs I played some vanilla, and the enemies there are much softer than our Normal. Hallway fights in an AP run were long, and later bosses were too hard. So I've toned scaling down across the board. There's also a new option to hide quest rewards, and a few bug fixes. Please send feedback with the template in the [Playtester guide](https://github.com/wrjones104/ffresonance-archipelago/blob/main/docs/playtester_guide.md).
### Downloads
| File | Description | |---|---| | `FFRArchipelago.zip` | UE4SS Lua game mod (v0.62.0, build `7b90595e`) | | `ff_resonance.apworld` | Archipelago world and Final Fantasy Resonance Client (v0.31.0, build `66073f7e`) | | `Final Fantasy Resonance.yaml` | Template player YAML with default options |
### Install and upgrade
- Use the mod and the apworld from the same release. The mod logs `version 0.62.0 (build 7b90595e)` to `UE4SS.log` when it loads, and the client prints `world version 0.31.0 (build 66073f7e)` when it starts. - Replace the whole `FFRArchipelago` folder in `ue4ss\Mods`, and put the new apworld in `custom_worlds`. Close the Launcher and every client window first. - Generate a new seed. Seeds from v0.30.0 have a gift location and four items this build no longer has, and the template yaml now asks for world 0.31.0. - Install steps are in the [README](https://github.com/wrjones104/ffresonance-archipelago#installation).
### What's changed since v0.30.0
**Scaling is softer.** Every **AP: Scaling strength** moved down a step:
| Strength | Enemy level | Enemy HP | Enemy Attack | Boss level | Boss power | |---|---|---|---|---|---| | Casual | 80% to 88% of yours | 60% to 75% | 75% to 90% | 95% to 100% | 90% to 100% | | Normal | 85% to 92% | 70% to 85% | 85% to 100% | 100% to 103% | 100% to 105% | | Expert | 90% to 100% | 80% to 105% | 90% to 115% | 105% to 110% | 105% to 110% |
Each range ramps from party level 5 to 25.
- On Normal, enemies now sit a bit under your level. They lose more HP than Attack, so fights end sooner but can still hurt if you're careless. - Enemies from areas ahead of you used to be 3 levels over the band's middle on Normal, which is where the spongy fights came from. Now they're 1 over. - Bosses on Normal sit at about your level. - Expert is roughly the old Normal with a bit less HP. If you want a real challenge, try Expert scaling with the game on Expert too. - Above party level 30, enemy levels grow 3 levels for every 4 you gain. The game's own enemy stats grow much faster than the party's in the late game, so enemies held at your level kept pulling ahead. At level 60 on Normal, the final boss now meets you at 54 instead of 66.
**MRP per fight stays the same.** Normally, lower enemy levels would mean less MRP per battle. Now MRP is paid as if the enemies were at your level, so the vision grind gets shorter, not longer, now that fights end sooner. If you want even less grind, the **AP: MRP rate** slider is still there.
**Hide quest rewards.** There's a new yaml option, `hide_quest_rewards` (off by default). With it on, every reward on the Quests screen shows `???` instead of the item it holds. You still see what you got when you finish the quest. It only matters with `include_side_quests` on.
**Items:** White Jade Stone, Black Jade Stone, Magic Tome and Tunnel Key aren't in the pool anymore. They don't open anything in an open world seed.
**Archipelago page:**
- The Seed tab now has the monitor icon instead of the speaker. - The rows on both tabs keep the same order every time you open the page. They used to shuffle around.
**The log** now gets a `battle: won` line after each win, with how long you were off the field. If you send your `UE4SS.log`, I can see how long fights really take.
**Fixes:**
- Some chests read as opened as soon as you arrived on a map and got sent before you touched them. The mod now waits until the game's save says the chest was really opened. - If you play the same save on two computers, chests you'd already opened on the other one get sent again with no pop-up, so they don't steal the next chest's pop-up anymore. - The coloured item line no longer sticks around on a quest's later messages (the stat bonus and "You can now summon..." lines). - Starting a plain **New Game**, or loading one of your own non-AP saves, no longer gets any of the seed's changes. A plain New Game used to start Rain at level 55. If you load the seed's save and then one of your own in the same session, the mod tells you to restart the game first.
**Gifts:**
- NPC gift locations are now named for where the NPC stands (like "Grandshelt - Colosseum - Upper East Terrace Gift") instead of the item they give in the base game. - I removed the Zoldaad Dungeon gift because it can't be reached from the open world start.
### Please test
Scaling is the big one. Note your **AP: Scaling strength** and the game's own difficulty when you report, and send `UE4SS.log` if you can.
- How long a normal fight takes on Normal, both in areas around your level and in areas ahead of you. They should be quick but not free. - Whether MRP per fight feels the same as before, and whether the vision grind feels better. - Bosses at party level 30 and up. Are they fair with what the seed has given you? - Levels 40 to 60, and the final boss at about level 60. If it's too easy up there now, tell me. The softer strengths and the late-game slowdown stack, and I'd rather tune the slowdown than the strengths. - Expert scaling with the game on Expert, if that's your thing. Hard but winnable is the goal. - `hide_quest_rewards`: every reward on the Quests screen should read `???` in white.
Bug fixes to check:
- On arrival in a new map, look for `never seen closed` lines in `UE4SS.log`. If a chest from one of those lines looks open in the game and you can never open it, send me its key (like `chest:3100:3`). - If you play one save on two computers, open a new chest on the second one and check that its pop-up shows its own item. - Finish a quest with a stat bonus or an esper, like Nichol's Duty in Olderion. The coloured item line should only be on the first message. - Start a plain **New Game** with the client connected. Rain should stay at level 1, and the log should say `Archipelago is paused`.
### Known issues
- When two checks come at once (a chest right after a boss win), the second pop-up can show the game's own item. The check is still sent. - Three NPC gifts aren't locations: the Ether NPC in the Commercial District, the Mist Potion NPC in Grandshelt Castle, and the Zoldaad Dungeon NPC. They give their normal items if you find them. - Character quests' stat bonuses (like "Attribute Bonus: Fina") aren't items. The quest gives them as in the base game. - I've had one crash about 6 hours in, a few seconds after landing the airship, with FFR_MapMarkers and FFRBestiary on. It doesn't look like this mod's loop, but I'm not sure yet. If you crash, send `Mods/FFRArchipelago/ap_trace.txt`, the crash folder in `%LOCALAPPDATA%\FFRS\Saved\Crashes`, and `UE4SS.log` before you start the game again. - The `ModSettings` Lua mod (from FFR Modding Tools) can crash the game a second or two after a map change, with or without this mod. To avoid it, turn off **Hint on map load** in its panel (F10), or set `ModSettings : 0` in `Mods\mods.txt`. - Mt. Thunderclap's shortcut ladder is invisible. You can still let it down from the top and climb it. - Not done yet: espers other than Siren come the vanilla way, and the Chamber of Arms and the Arena are untouched.
Most of this project's code and docs were written with Claude and tested by hand; see [DISCLOSURE.md](https://github.com/wrjones104/ffresonance-archipelago/blob/main/DISCLOSURE.md) for details.

entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1r4
entry.content:
A mix of bug fixes, quality of life, and one new feature in this release. The main additions are new locations from Resourcesanity (but note a bug that needs to be worked around in this release!) and the ability to peek what items will be sent when you spend a Great Person (with other types of peeks coming soon).
### Changelog: - Resourcesanity is available in an initial form. A check is sent when you have at least one instance of a resource available in your capital, either by connecting it naturally or getting it via trade. The logic makes sure you have the techs needed to reveal and connect the given resource (or make a corporation for it in the case of Aluminum and Oil), and additionally requires Iron Working to connect Calendar resources (as the majority of them are placed in jungle on "normal" maps). You also aren't guaranteed to have every resource on every map and may need to generate another game to get all checks. - If Peekable Locations is set to either "Great People" or "All" in the YAML, the option to "bulb" a location will show the name of the item you're sending. In this initial implementation GPs are the only location that's peekable, it doesn't say who the item is for, or what type the item is (Progression/Useful/Filler/Trap), all of which are planned for later updates. - Fixed Archipelago Communism being named Archipelago Utopia, causing the location not to send. - Did lots of refactoring and code cleanup that's not interesting to users
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. If a resource is made obsolete (Fur, Whale, and Ivory from Plastics, Combustion, and Industrialism respectively) it will not send! The easiest way to fix this is removing the tech in World Builder for a turn, sending the check, then re-adding the tech. 2. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain. 3. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 4. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 5. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel). 6. The "AP" Unique Units can't be upgraded into, though they can be upgraded themselves. This is planned to be fixed in an upcoming update. 7. AP Unique Buildings are programmed assuming you don't have a "natural" Unique Building for your Civilization for purposes like avoiding duplicates of the same class of building, so if you use a Civilization other than AP World things could break. 8. If a building has a requirement to be built (such as the University), and you build an AP Unique Building version of it (such as the Seowon), you aren't able to build the original version anymore. There's no reason why you'd need to do this (the only vanilla building that's not strictly worse than the UB alternatives is the Theatre/Hippodrome, and that doesn't suffer the bug), but it's weird behavior.
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet. 4. If you add Unique Buildings to the itempool, it causes a noticeable amount of lag when entering the city screen in some cases (due to the coding I need to make them work how I want them to). I think it scales with the amount of cities you have, but it also might be just a memory leak. If you experience this lag (or don't and think you would), let me know!
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/

This is a **RELEASE CANDIDATE** for a new "GameCube" version of the ap world, including a way to play on your modded Wii! The PC port has no visible changes but has been almost entirely refactored, so if you want to help test by playing the PC port, you still can!
